title: 動物の名札
subject_en: Cute kawaii animals each holding or wearing a blank rectangular name plate with empty white-cream area for writing, each ONE animal centred. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 動物が空白の名札を持った12点です。名前や学年を書き足して、ロッカー・下駄箱・席札に使えます。
